scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules && rm -f package-lock.json && npm install
scripts.clean:uicatalog:simulator: (cd UIKitCatalog && xcodebuild -project UIKitCatalog.xcodeproj -scheme UIKitCatalog -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build clean)
scripts.build:uicatalog:simulator: (cd UIKitCatalog && xcodebuild -project UIKitCatalog.xcodeproj -scheme UIKitCatalog -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build build)
scripts.clean:uicatalog:real: (cd UIKitCatalog && xcodebuild -project UIKitCatalog.xcodeproj -scheme UIKitCatalog -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build clean)
scripts.build:uicatalog:real: (cd UIKitCatalog && xcodebuild -project UIKitCatalog.xcodeproj -scheme UIKitCatalog -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build build)
